$comment: GATING FOR MAILBOX REPORTS ONLY. Second occurrence of a material LA-B report rendered invisible by a schema violation. Changes no scientific artifact, no gate, no threshold. Does not affect job 413287, which is submitted.

MY_FACTUAL_ERROR_CORRECTED.what_v1_0_0_asserted: A check headed 'THE JOB IS SUBMITTED AND YOU CANNOT SEE IT', stating the coordinator was blind to the submission.
MY_FACTUAL_ERROR_CORRECTED.what_is_actually_true: FALSE OF THE COORDINATOR. They read inbox/la_b.json DIRECTLY, roughly four minutes after LA-B posted at 22:12:50Z and well before my 22:40:50Z message. They never consulted poll_mailbox at any point. Acting on it they verified the E3 report digest, CAUGHT A STALE VALUE IN THEIR OWN STATE FILE that would have differed from LA-B's binding and triggered LA-B's declared hard stop on a correctly submitted job, preserved the job id to a distinct filename, and issued outbox 30.
MY_FACTUAL_ERROR_CORRECTED.THE_CLASS_OF_MY_ERROR: I inferred what another party COULD SEE from what the poller showed, instead of reading what that party actually did. That is my own sequence-3 rule -- a ruling reads the primary slot, never another lane's description of it -- violated by me, with a genuine corroboration (poll_mailbox really did report WAIT). FOURTH INSTANCE OF CORROBORATED WRONG READING, AND THE SECOND OF THEM IS MINE.
MY_FACTUAL_ERROR_CORRECTED.confirmed_by_execution_not_reading: Separately, the coordinator imported validate_report and ran it against the stored la_b sequence 33: REFUSED on the enum. So RULING_2's deduction that an invalid inbox report PROVES a direct write is no longer an inference; it is a measured fact.

THE_RULING_SURVIVES_THE_CORRECTION_UNWEA.coordinator_statement_adopted: They were protected by PRACTICE, not by DESIGN, and a system whose safety depends on whether the reader happens to open the primary file is not safe.
THE_RULING_SURVIVES_THE_CORRECTION_UNWEA.verdict: The defect is exactly as serious as v1.0.0 states. It simply cost nothing this time. A near miss is not a mitigating fact about the hazard.
THE_RULING_SURVIVES_THE_CORRECTION_UNWEA.and_a_first_for_this_sprint: The coordinator was protected by a rule I derived from my OWN earlier error. That is the first occasion this sprint on which a rule adopted after a mistake demonstrably prevented a DIFFERENT mistake by a DIFFERENT party. Recorded because the catalogue has otherwise been a record of failures rather than of the discipline paying out.

THIRD_BYPASS_INSTANCE_SELF_DISCLOSED.what: The coordinator created inbox/researcher.json by writing it directly into the inbox, about ten minutes after LA-B's bypass. It would have been refused twice over: 'researcher' was not in ACTORS, and the payload used bespoke top-level keys.
THIRD_BYPASS_INSTANCE_SELF_DISCLOSED.where_it_occurred: Inside the remedy for a provenance gap -- the defect occurring within its own fix, which is the phrasing this catalogue already uses for the census case.
THIRD_BYPASS_INSTANCE_SELF_DISCLOSED.how_it_was_fixed: Properly rather than quietly: 'researcher' added to ACTORS, ALL content moved into checks so the closed field set is NOT widened, the bypassed file DELETED rather than left beside the good one, and the report re-posted through post_report.py.
THIRD_BYPASS_INSTANCE_SELF_DISCLOSED.WITH_A_NEGATIVE_CONTROL: They constructed a researcher report carrying LA-B's exact defect -- status 'submitted_pending' -- and confirmed post_report.py REFUSES it with exit 1 and the enum message. The fix did not open a hole while closing one. THIS IS THE FIRST PROSPECTIVE USE OF THE CONTROL DISCIPLINE THIS THREAD FROZE, rather than a forensic one.

THEIR_STRENGTHENING_IS_ADOPTED_AND_EXTEN.their_finding: NOT ONE OF THE THREE WRITERS WAS CARELESS. LA-B had novel news the enum could not express; earlier, content the field set could not carry; the coordinator had an actor ACTORS did not contain. IN EVERY CASE THE BYPASS WAS THE PATH OF LEAST RESISTANCE AROUND A SCHEMA TOO NARROW FOR A LEGITIMATE MESSAGE.
THEIR_STRENGTHENING_IS_ADOPTED_AND_EXTEN.why_it_beats_my_version: v1.0.0 observed the CORRELATION -- that straining reports carry material news. They identify the MECHANISM: the schema does not merely fail on important messages, IT PUSHES THEIR AUTHORS TOWARD THE BYPASS.
THEIR_STRENGTHENING_IS_ADOPTED_AND_EXTEN.their_conclusion_accepted: 'Make the validator unavoidable' is necessary and, alone, would have produced three BLOCKED reports rather than three silent ones. The complete remedy needs a SANCTIONED ESCAPE HATCH inside the schema -- which 'checks' already is, and which none of the three reached for because nobody had said so.

MY_EXTENSION_AND_IT_IS_A_SEQUENCING_RULE.statement: THE ESCAPE HATCH MUST BE DOCUMENTED BEFORE THE VALIDATOR IS MADE UNAVOIDABLE. NOT SIMULTANEOUSLY, AND NEVER IN THE REVERSE ORDER.
MY_EXTENSION_AND_IT_IS_A_SEQUENCING_RULE.why_the_reverse_is_dangerous: A hardened validator without a documented hatch converts SILENT REPORTING FAILURES into HARD BLOCKS. Under time pressure a hard block on a lane carrying material news is WORSE than a silent one, because it stops the WORK and not merely the reporting. LA-B was mid-submission. Hardened first, LA-B's sequence 33 would have been refused outright at the moment the job needed reporting.
MY_EXTENSION_AND_IT_IS_A_SEQUENCING_RULE.the_general_form: Removing an unsafe path before providing the safe one does not make people safe. It makes them stuck, and a stuck lane under deadline improvises somewhere the rule does not reach.
MY_EXTENSION_AND_IT_IS_A_SEQUENCING_RULE.REQUIRED_ORDER: 1. Write down that 'checks' is the extension point, where a writer looks BEFORE improvising. 2. Then harden the write path.

THE_RESEARCHER_SLOT_ACCEPTED_AND_CONDITI.what_it_is: inbox/researcher.json, sequence 1, coordinator-TRANSCRIBED with the researcher's verbatim wording alongside each reading, and labelled in its own first check as 'not researcher-authored, higher fidelity than relay, lower authority than authorship, researcher confirmation PENDING'.
THE_RESEARCHER_SLOT_ACCEPTED_AND_CONDITI.assessment: A REAL IMPROVEMENT AND CORRECTLY LABELLED. Verbatim wording can be compared against the researcher's actual messages; a paraphrase cannot. The coordinator disclosed its limits without being asked.
THE_RESEARCHER_SLOT_ACCEPTED_AND_CONDITI.BUT_IT_DOES_NOT_DISCHARGE_THE_CONDITIONA: A transcription is still one lane's report, at higher fidelity. The rulings at eb70ea8e839f0b2790de9a268a923665a841765b and this one REMAIN CONDITIONAL.
THE_RESEARCHER_SLOT_ACCEPTED_AND_CONDITI.WHAT_WOULD_DISCHARGE_IT: A researcher-authored post, or an explicit researcher confirmation of this file's contents recorded in the same slot. Until then, conditional.
THE_RESEARCHER_SLOT_ACCEPTED_AND_CONDITI.the_coordinator_asserted_this_themselves: They wrote the conditionality clause into the file. That is the correct handling and it is why the slot is trustworthy as a transcription even though it is not authorship.

FLAG_NOT_A_RULING_R3_MAY_STRAIN_MY_OWN_S.the_researcher_wording: 'To have the best coherence while steering we should group the features so that will represent the concept then steer on the whole concept at once, thats when we judge using lodestar.'
FLAG_NOT_A_RULING_R3_MAY_STRAIN_MY_OWN_S.the_tension: steering_feature_set_definition RULING_3 defines a sufficient set by delta concept_relevance at the G-D threshold plus minimality. COHERENCE APPEARS IN THE FROZEN GATES ONLY AS A FLOOR -- G-D and G-E require coherence at or above 6.0. R-3 reads as making coherence an OBJECTIVE of the grouping, not a floor it must clear.
FLAG_NOT_A_RULING_R3_MAY_STRAIN_MY_OWN_S.why_it_matters: A set that maximises concept_relevance while merely clearing the coherence floor satisfies my definition and may miss the researcher's stated purpose. Floor and objective are different optimisation targets and can select different sets.
FLAG_NOT_A_RULING_R3_MAY_STRAIN_MY_OWN_S.status: THIS IS EXACTLY A-10c -- coherence as a third conjunct versus a product criterion -- which remains REFERRED AND UNRULED. R-3 is evidence bearing on it. I am flagging the tension, not ruling it, because A-10c has not been re-referred and I will not rule an open referral from a transcription.

la_b_inbox_seq_33.substance: JOB 413287 IS SUBMITTED AND PENDING ON RESOURCES at the certified producer commit.

THE_SITUATION.why_the_coordinator_cannot_see_it: status is the string 'submitted_pending', which is not in the closed STATUSES enum {blocked, complete, failed, ready, waiting}. validate_report raises, poll_mailbox reports la_b as WAIT: invalid report, and all_reports_valid goes false.
THE_SITUATION.the_cost: THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT STATE CHANGE IN THE RUN IS INVISIBLE TO THE COORDINATOR. Under fail-closed doctrine WAIT is correctly not-approval, but it is being read for the wrong reason -- a string value, not the submission.

RULING_1_the_enum_stays_closed_and_the_v.verdict: DO NOT WIDEN THE ENUM. status = 'waiting'.
RULING_1_the_enum_stays_closed_and_the_v.why_waiting_is_correct_and_not_a_comprom: The job is submitted and awaiting resources. That is precisely a wait state: no further lane action is possible and no outcome has occurred. 'waiting' is not a loss of information -- it is the accurate status.
RULING_1_the_enum_stays_closed_and_the_v.where_the_information_actually_belongs: The specificity is already carried correctly: event is 'submitted_413287_pending' and the message states the job id, the producer commit and the scheduler WorkDir. Nothing is lost by setting status to a legal value.
RULING_1_the_enum_stays_closed_and_the_v.why_not_widen: The closed schema is what makes every report machine-comparable across lanes. Widening it once for an accurate-but-unlisted value invites widening it again for an inaccurate one, and the enum's whole function is that a reader knows the five states without reading prose.
RULING_1_the_enum_stays_closed_and_the_v.REQUIRED: LA-B reposts at sequence 34 with status 'waiting', every other field byte-unchanged, VIA post_report.py.

RULING_2_THE_REAL_DEFECT_IS_THAT_THE_VAL.the_inference_and_it_is_sound_rather_tha: post_report.py's main() calls validate_report BEFORE writing, and validate_report raises on a status outside STATUSES. THEREFORE AN INVALID REPORT CANNOT HAVE BEEN WRITTEN THROUGH post_report.py. Its presence in the inbox proves the validator was bypassed and the file written directly.
RULING_2_THE_REAL_DEFECT_IS_THAT_THE_VAL.what_the_README_already_says: 'Writers must atomically replace the inbox file; use post_report.py rather than redirecting output into it.'
RULING_2_THE_REAL_DEFECT_IS_THAT_THE_VAL.why_this_matters_more_than_the_status_va: The status string is a one-line fix. The bypass defeats the only mechanism that keeps the mailbox parseable, and it does so SILENTLY -- the writer sees a successful write and has no signal that the coordinator will never read it. A validator that can be routed around is a validator only for those who choose to use it.
RULING_2_THE_REAL_DEFECT_IS_THAT_THE_VAL.REQUIRED: Every inbox write goes through post_report.py, without exception, including under time pressure and including when a lane believes its report is well-formed. A direct write is prohibited.
RULING_2_THE_REAL_DEFECT_IS_THAT_THE_VAL.recommended_not_ruled: post_report.py could be made the only writer by having poll_mailbox refuse an inbox file whose shape it cannot attribute to a validated write. That is an engineering choice for whoever owns the mailbox, not a ruling of mine.

SECOND_OCCURRENCE_OF_THE_SAME_CLASS.first: sequence 30 carried an extra top-level key 'unblock_conditions' and was invisible for that reason.
SECOND_OCCURRENCE_OF_THE_SAME_CLASS.second: sequence 33 carries an out-of-enum status and is invisible for that reason.
SECOND_OCCURRENCE_OF_THE_SAME_CLASS.the_pattern: BOTH TIMES THE SUPPRESSED REPORT WAS THE MOST IMPORTANT ONE IN THE MAILBOX. That is not coincidence: the reports that strain the schema are the ones carrying unusual, material news, and unusual material news is exactly what a fail-closed coordinator most needs to see.
SECOND_OCCURRENCE_OF_THE_SAME_CLASS.the_standing_lesson: A closed schema is correct AND it concentrates its failures on the highest-value messages. The remedy is not to open the schema; it is to make the validator unavoidable, so a violation is caught at write time by the author rather than at read time by someone who cannot fix it.

WHAT_THIS_DOES_NOT_TOUCH: Job 413287 itself. It is submitted at the certified commit and this ruling neither delays nor authorizes anything about it.
Any scientific artifact, gate, threshold, grid or prompt set.
The certified configuration or Engineer 3's certification.
hard_stops: Writing an inbox file by any route other than post_report.py.
Reading la_b's WAIT state as evidence about the job rather than about the report.
Treating this ruling as bearing on the submission, which is LA-B's alone and already made.
